u0: The agent is not holding the box, either at the start or after the box has fallen or been released. The immediate objective is to reach the box and pick it up; becoming holding_box transitions to u1 and earns the pickup progress reward. If the box has just fallen, recover it before heading to the exit.
u1: The agent is holding the box and has earned the pickup progress reward. The objective is to keep possession and navigate to the green exit. If box_fell occurs, the agent returns to u0 and must pick the box up again. Reaching the exit while still holding the box completes the task and transitions to u2.
u2: Terminal success: the agent has reached the exit while holding the box. The task is complete and no further objective or reward remains.
